description: The input and output price per million tokens that was IN EFFECT on a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), with the source that proves it. This is the point-in-time lookup: use it to value past usage or to see how a price changed over time. covered=false means the date predates the model's recorded coverage.

date.description: The date to price, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-01-01".

provider.description: Optional provider slug to disambiguate a bare id.

name: price_on
title: Price on a date
